agent_reports.devils_advocate:
I checked every cross-reference the new Section 10 makes against the actual body text of the sections it cites (Section 1's two-challenger/prose claim, Section 5.1's Dawn Phase draw, Section 6.2's resolution atomicity, Section 8.2/8.6's Homeworld-capture ban) — all check out faithfully. The one place the diff fails its own stated discipline is a citation error introduced in the glossary.

**Finding (INTRODUCED):** The new glossary entry for **Eliminated** (design/rules.md:124-127) states: "an Eliminated challenger takes no further turns and receives no further priority (**Section 10.2**)." But Section 10.2 (lines 724-740, added by this same diff) never mentions priority at all — it only defines when the game ends and that no further turn is taken. The word "priority" doesn't appear anywhere in the new Section 10 body (10.1, 10.2, or 10.3).

**Failure scenario:** A reader (or a future card author) needs to know whether an Eliminated player can still be asked for priority — e.g., a future Fast card or trigger that resolves after one player hits 0 Core Integrity but before game-end processing completes. They follow the glossary's citation to Section 10.2 expecting to find the rule, and it isn't there. The claim is asserted only in the glossary itself, with a citation to a section that doesn't support it — exactly the failure mode this unit's own preamble (line 697-698: "where a rule already exists, this section cross-references it by section number instead [of restating it]") is designed to prevent.
